mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, indicating a rapidly weakening labor market, will trigger a risk-off sentiment that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates sharply, indicating supply chain disruptions, it will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Decelerating INDPRO is accompanied by falling input costs (e.g., copper prices) that offset the earnings impact.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates, signaling a tightening labor market, it will boost wage inflation and consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Accelerating PAYEMS growth is accompanied by a flattening yield curve, indicating that the Fed will hike rates aggressively to combat wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth decelerates sharply, indicating a weakening housing market, it will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Decelerating HOUST growth is accompanied by falling mortgage rates that stimulate housing demand.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, it will negatively impact corporate borrowing costs and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% is accompanied by falling inflation expectations (e.g., breakeven rates) that offset the impact of higher borrowing costs.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth accelerates, signaling a strengthening consumer sector, it will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Accelerating RSAFS growth is accompanied by a widening credit spread that indicates rising consumer default risk.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4%, indicating a very tight labor market, it will boost wage inflation and negatively impact corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% is accompanied by accelerating productivity growth that offsets the impact of higher wages on profit margins.
